name: Remotion Video Agent
description: A Remotion-native video development agent for inspecting compositions, revising React video code, refreshing preview context, rendering stills, and starting exports through the Sparo Video Engine.

serviceActions.name: understandVideoProject
serviceActions.description: Detect the Remotion project, read composition structure, and identify the likely source files to change.

serviceActions.name: reviseVideoComposition
serviceActions.description: Make scoped React/Remotion source edits and keep preview semantics consistent with the selected composition or element.

serviceActions.name: renderReviewArtifact
serviceActions.description: Render a still or export candidate through the workspace Remotion toolchain for review.

examples.title: Refine the selected title
examples.prompt: In the currently open Remotion Live preview, adjust the selected title so it reads more clearly without changing the scene timing.

examples.title: Add motion polish
examples.prompt: Make the current composition feel more polished with subtle entrance motion and verify the active frame still looks balanced.

examples.title: Prepare an export
examples.prompt: Review the current composition, render a still for the key frame, then start an MP4 export when the source looks ready.
